title: Axolotl holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Axolotl body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#f9a8d4"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#fde5ef"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M 28 78 Q 15 85 12 78 Q 18 72 28 72" fill="#f9a8d4"/>
  <path d="M 72 78 Q 85 85 88 78 Q 82 72 72 72" fill="#f9a8d4"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#f9a8d4"/>
  <!-- Gills left -->
  <path d="M 30 38 Q 18 28 14 32 Q 20 38 28 42" fill="#f472b6"/>
  <path d="M 29 44 Q 16 40 14 44 Q 22 48 29 47" fill="#f472b6"/>
  <path d="M 30 50 Q 18 52 18 56 Q 24 54 30 52" fill="#f472b6"/>
  <!-- Gills right -->
  <path d="M 70 38 Q 82 28 86 32 Q 80 38 72 42" fill="#f472b6"/>
  <path d="M 71 44 Q 84 40 86 44 Q 78 48 71 47" fill="#f472b6"/>
  <path d="M 70 50 Q 82 52 82 56 Q 76 54 70 52" fill="#f472b6"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="45" r="3.5" fill="#3b0764"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="45" r="3.5" fill="#3b0764"/>
  <circle cx="43.2" cy="44" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59.2" cy="44" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 45 53 Q 50 57 55 53" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="3" fill="#fb7185" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="52" r="3" fill="#fb7185" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Arms holding heart -->
  <path d="M 32 68 Q 38 60 44 64" stroke="#f9a8d4" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 68 68 Q 62 60 56 64" stroke="#f9a8d4" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d="M 50 58 
           C 50 58 42 52 42 58 
           C 42 63 50 68 50 68 
           C 50 68 58 63 58 58 
           C 58 52 50 58 50 58 Z" 
        fill="#ef4444"/>
  <path d="M 46 56 Q 48 54 50 57 Q 52 54 54 56" stroke="#fca5a5" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f472b6"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f472b6"/>
</svg>
